arguments.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Draw a two-panel pencil storyboard for two added scenes of The Monkey Menace. Not finished color art. Original photos 1-4 govern dog identity, fifth image interpreted model only. Panel A wide rooftop Ahmedabad bungalow: aftermath of laundry yanked down but before dogs charge. At left only Heather's blue jean legs and white sneakers, striped shirt cropped torso and hand holding chai cup. Neet small fawn fine long legs full narrow body large triangular ears tiny nub, standing alert beside her facing right. Buddy dark moderately elongated full body substantial legs pale feet moustache brows softly hanging ears, just behind her with cautious backward weight. Behind at right a macaque seated on low parapet eating mango; bright dupattas fallen over soil on floor, one overturned pot, potted mango tree, clothesline. No broom yet. Panel B closer lower viewpoint: Buddy beside Heather's same legs barks toward right at smaller macaque on planter. Monkey stopped chewing mango and looks surprised. Buddy looks back over his own shoulder for one beat wondering who barked; four legs supported, full continuous torso/neck. Neet remains deeper background facing scarred leader on central pillar, and thrown watering can on floor. Keep dog bodies separated and rooted limbs easy to inspect, substantial clearance below Buddy. Visible pencil ribcage/pelvis/limb roots and floor perspective; no hatching implying long torso fur. Both scenes have no contact or injuries. No text, labels or speech balloons.
